title: Perplexity Teammates Agents Launch on Mac for Max Users
summary: Perplexity expands Teammates agentic workflows to macOS on November 13, 2026, giving $200/month Max subscribers persistent AI agents for QA, research, and more.
body_markdown:
#### 💡 TL;DR


- Perplexity rolled out Teammates persistent AI agents to its Mac app on November 13, 2026.
- The feature requires a $200 monthly Max subscription and supports parallel QA, research, customer service, and marketing agents.
- Teammates launched on web the prior week and is now available across web, iOS, and macOS platforms.


Perplexity expanded its Teammates agentic feature to the macOS app on November 13, 2026, bringing[persistent AI agents](https://emergent.sh/learn/best-ai-agents-for-business) to desktop users who subscribe to the company's $200-per-month Max plan. The rollout follows the web launch from the prior week and marks the third platform in roughly two weeks to receive the always-on agent capability.


## What Teammates Does


Teammates are persistent AI agents designed to handle ongoing business tasks without manual intervention. Users assign a responsibility to an agent, such as managing a growth campaign, triaging bug reports, tracking metrics, or researching a new market, and the agent owns that work continuously. The feature supports QA testing, customer service, research workflows, and[growth marketing](https://emergent.sh/learn/ai-agents-for-marketing) operations.


The system allows multiple agent instances to run in parallel, differentiating it from single-model assistants. According to 9to5Mac, this multi-agent architecture resembles features like Grok Bot, Meta Muse, and ChatGPT Dots, but Perplexity's implementation supports several specialized agents operating simultaneously rather than a single conversational interface.


## Pricing and Platform Availability


Access to Teammates remains gated behind Perplexity's Max subscription tier, priced at $200 per month or $2,000 annually. No pricing changes accompanied the Mac release. The feature officially launched on the web during the first week of November 2026, appeared on iOS shortly after, and arrived on macOS on November 13, 2026. Perplexity announced the Mac rollout in a single sentence on X: "Teammates are now available in the Perplexity Mac app for Max subscribers."


## Use Cases and Workflow Integration


The four primary use cases Perplexity highlights are quality assurance, customer service automation, research projects, and growth marketing. A QA agent can continuously monitor bug reports and triage issues by severity. A customer service agent can field inquiries and route complex cases to human operators. A research agent can track industry news and compile competitive intelligence. A growth marketing agent can monitor campaign performance and adjust targeting parameters.


Each agent operates as a persistent background process, meaning users do not need to manually trigger tasks or maintain an open session. The agents work around the clock and surface insights or completed work when ready.


## Release Timeline


Officially launched on November 13, 2026, the Mac version of Teammates followed the web and iOS releases by less than two weeks. Perplexity introduced Teammates on its web platform in early November 2026, then brought the feature to iOS before expanding to macOS. The rapid cross-platform rollout suggests the company prioritized Max subscribers across all surfaces before considering broader availability.


## What This Means


Perplexity's Teammates expansion to Mac completes the initial cross-platform rollout for its premium agent feature. The $200 monthly price point positions Teammates as an enterprise-grade tool for small teams and power users who need persistent automation across research, marketing, QA, and support functions. The multi-agent architecture and always-on execution model distinguish Teammates from conversational assistants, framing it as a workflow automation layer rather than a chat interface. With the Mac app now supporting Teammates alongside web and iOS, Perplexity has unified the experience for Max subscribers across all major platforms in under a month.
